items.title: ZDI-CAN-31619: NoMachine
items.description: A CVSS score 7.2 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Niels Pfau (Mantodea Security GmbH)' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-08-07, 1 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-12-05 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
